legacyTitle: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course, Get Certified
legacyDescription: Join our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course and become a professional yoga instructor. Start your transformative journey today!

blocks.text: Avana Yoga is providing a 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course. This course is designed for individuals who want to deepen their knowledge of yoga and become certified yoga teachers. Avana Yoga’s teacher training program provides students with comprehensive training in various aspects of yoga, including asana, pranayama, meditation, philosophy, and anatomy. The course is conducted by experienced yoga teachers who have years of experience in teaching yoga and are committed to helping students become excellent yoga teachers.

The 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course offered by Avana Yoga is a comprehensive program that covers all aspects of yoga. Students will learn about the history and philosophy of yoga, as well as the various yoga styles and techniques. The course will also cover anatomy and physiology, teaching methodology, and hands-on practice teaching. The course is designed to help students develop the skills and knowledge necessary to become confident and competent yoga teachers.

One of the unique features of the 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course at Avana Yoga is the emphasis on hands-on practice teaching. Students will have the opportunity to practice teaching yoga to their classmates under the guidance of experienced teachers. This provides students with valuable feedback and allows them to develop their teaching skills in a supportive and constructive environment.

Another unique feature of the course is the focus on anatomy and physiology. Students will learn about the human body and how it relates to yoga practice. This knowledge is essential for teaching yoga safely and effectively, and it is a critical aspect of becoming a knowledgeable and effective yoga teacher.

The course is also designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of yoga philosophy and its practical applications. Students will study the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali, the Bhagavad Gita, and other important yoga texts. This knowledge will help students deepen their personal practice and develop a deeper understanding of the spiritual aspects of yoga.

Avana Yoga’s 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course is a Yoga Alliance certified program, which means that upon completion of the course, students will be eligible to register with Yoga Alliance as Registered Yoga Teachers (RYT). This certification is recognized globally and is an important credential for anyone who wants to teach yoga professionally.
In addition to the comprehensive training provided in the course, Avana Yoga also offers a range of services to support students during and after the course. These services include:

items.title: Accommodation
items.text: Avana Yoga provides comfortable and affordable accommodation options for students who are taking the course. The accommodation is located close to the yoga studio and provides a peaceful and supportive environment for students to focus on their studies and practice.

items.title: Healthy Meals
items.text: Avana Yoga provides healthy and nutritious meals for students during the course. The meals are vegetarian and are designed to support a yoga practice.

items.title: Community
items.text: Avana Yoga is a community of like-minded individuals who share a passion for yoga. Students who take the course become part of this community and have access to ongoing support and guidance from experienced teachers and fellow students.

items.title: Continuing Education
items.text: Avana Yoga offers a range of continuing education courses and workshops for yoga teachers. These courses are designed to help teachers deepen their knowledge and skills and stay up to date with the latest developments in the yoga world.

items.title: Personal Growth
items.text: The 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course at Avana Yoga is not just about becoming a yoga teacher. It is also an opportunity for personal growth and transformation. Students who take the course often report that they have gained a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them.

items.title: Experienced and Knowledgeable Teachers
items.text: The teachers at Avana Yoga are highly experienced and knowledgeable in the field of yoga. They have dedicated their lives to the practice of yoga and have undergone extensive training to become certified yoga teachers. They are passionate about sharing their knowledge and helping students to develop a deep understanding of the practice of yoga. The teachers at Avana Yoga will guide you through every aspect of the course, from the philosophy of yoga to the practical aspects of teaching.

items.title: Comprehensive Curriculum
items.text: The curriculum at Avana Yoga is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the practice of yoga. The course covers a wide range of topics, including yoga philosophy, asana practice, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, and teaching methodology. The curriculum is designed to ensure that students have a solid foundation in all aspects of yoga, enabling them to become confident and competent yoga teachers.

items.title: Small Class Sizes
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that small class sizes are essential for providing high-quality training. That’s why we limit our class sizes to ensure that each student receives personalized attention from our teachers. This approach allows our teachers to focus on the individual needs of each student, ensuring that they receive the support and guidance they need to succeed.

items.title: Certification
items.text: Upon completion of the 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course, students will receive a certification from Avana Yoga. Our certification is internationally recognized, allowing you to teach yoga in any country in the world. The certification is also recognized by the Yoga Alliance, which is the largest international nonprofit association representing the yoga community. This recognition provides our students with the confidence and credibility they need to pursue a career in yoga.

items.title: Community
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that the community is an essential aspect of the practice of yoga. We have created a warm and welcoming community of students and teachers who support each other on their yoga journey. Our community provides a space for students to connect, share experiences, and develop lifelong friendships. We also offer ongoing support to our graduates, providing them with opportunities to continue their learning and development.

blocks.text: At Avana Yoga, we are proud to offer high-quality yoga teacher trainings at beautiful locations: the United Kingdom and India. We believe that the location of a training is just as important as the training itself, which is why we take great care in selecting our venues. In both the UK and India, we seek out serene and inspiring environments that allow our students to fully immerse themselves in the teachings of yoga. We know that a peaceful and supportive atmosphere is essential for personal growth and transformation, and we strive to create just that for our trainees. Our trainings are carefully crafted to maximize the benefits of yoga, and we believe that location plays a key role in this process. In addition to learning the ins and outs of yoga practice and instruction, our trainees will have the opportunity to explore the beauty and culture of their surroundings.

items.title: Affordability
items.text: At Avana Yoga, we believe that yoga should be accessible to everyone. That’s why we offer our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course at an affordable price. We believe that high-quality yoga training should not be prohibitively expensive, and we strive to make our courses accessible to all.

items.q: What is the duration of the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course offered by Avana Yoga is a comprehensive program that spans over the duration of 21 days.

items.q: What is the eligibility criteria for enrolling in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: There is no specific eligibility criteria for enrolling in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course. However, it is recommended that students should have a basic understanding of yoga postures and philosophy before enrolling in the course.

items.q: What will be the course curriculum of the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course curriculum covers a wide range of topics such as yoga philosophy, anatomy and physiology, teaching methodology, asanas, pranayama, meditation, and more. The course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of yoga and its various aspects.

items.q: What kind of certification will I receive after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Upon successful completion of the course, students will receive a certification from Avana Yoga, which is recognized by the Yoga Alliance. This certification will enable students to become registered yoga teachers and teach yoga anywhere in the world.

items.q: Will I be able to teach yoga after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Yes, upon successful completion of the course, students will be eligible to teach yoga. However, it is important to note that becoming a good yoga teacher requires continuous learning and practice, and it may take some time before you become confident in your teaching abilities.

items.q: Is accommodation provided during the course?
a: Yes, accommodation is provided by Avana Yoga during the course. The accommodation is comfortable and located in close proximity to the yoga studio.

items.q: What is the class size for the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The class size for the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course is limited to 20 students. This ensures that each student receives individual attention and guidance from the teachers.

items.q: What is the teaching methodology used in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: The teaching methodology used in the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course is a combination of traditional and modern approaches. The course emphasizes the importance of experiential learning and provides ample opportunities for students to practice teaching under the guidance of experienced teachers.

items.q: Will I be able to continue my regular job while taking the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: It is recommended that students take a break from their regular job while taking the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course. The course requires full-time commitment and dedication, and it may be difficult to balance a regular job along with the course.

items.q: What kind of support will I receive after completing the Avana Yoga 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training Course?
a: Avana Yoga provides continuous support to its students even after they complete the course. Students can reach out to the teachers for guidance and support, and Avana Yoga also provides opportunities for students to continue their learning through advanced courses and workshops.
